title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
slides: Cognition bought Poke. What for, exactly?
Poke built AI that remembers how you talk.
Most AI ignores tone—Poke makes it core.
Your chatbot can now match your brand's voice.
Audiences trust consistency. Train yours today.
thread_text:
1. Why buy a memory startup?

Cognition just acquired Poke, a company that makes chatbots remember your tone across conversations.

2. Tone is the missing layer.

Most AI treats every message like it's from a blank slate. Poke built a model that learns from your actual writing.

3. One voice, everywhere.

Your brand's assistant can now reply in your cadence—formal for support, casual for sales—without you writing rules.

4. Consistency builds trust.

Audiences notice when a bot sounds different each time. Poke eliminates that friction by locking vocal patterns.

5. Train your tone today.

Take a recent customer chat, paste it into your bot's training set. Does the reply sound like you? If not, adjust now.

instagram.caption:
That bot that sounds like a different person every time you chat? A company just bought the tech to kill that problem. 🎯

Cognition acquired Poke, a startup whose AI learns your actual writing tone—how you sign off, where you pause, when you’re formal. Most AI treats every message as a blank slate. Poke trained a model on your real chats instead.

For anyone publishing content: your brand’s bot can now speak in your cadence without rule-writing. Consistency builds trust. Audiences notice when the voice shifts.

Pick one customer email you sent last week. Does your current bot sound like you wrote it? If not, what’s the exact difference? 📝
